summary: Build practical product discovery, prioritization, and roadmap skills in 5 days. Train your team to manage digital products with confidence.
lede: Digital product management gives teams a structured way to discover customer needs, prioritize features, and guide products from planning through release and review. For professionals working with digital products, the course develops customer interview and problem-framing skills, evidence-based prioritization using MoSCoW and Kano, and roadmap planning informed by product KPIs.
audienceIntro: This Digital Product Management Foundations Training is designed for professionals who already work around digital products and need a more structured way to define problems, prioritize features, and communicate product decisions.
prerequisites: Ideal preparation includes 1 to 2 years of experience in a product, project, business analysis, UX, engineering, marketing, or data role, plus a working understanding of digital products and cross-functional delivery. No coding is required for completion, but you should be comfortable reading product metrics, backlog items, and customer feedback. If you bring a live product challenge, roadmap, or feature backlog, you will get more value from the exercises.
